description: This file defines CLI commands and utilities for managing Flask applications, including running a development server, opening a shell, and displaying routes. It handles application discovery, environment setup, and command registration.

classes.name: ScriptInfo
classes.description: Helper class for managing Flask application loading, environment setup, and context management within CLI commands.

classes.name: CertParamType
classes.description: Custom click parameter type for SSL certificate options, supporting file paths, 'adhoc', or SSLContext objects.

classes.name: SeparatedPathType
classes.description: Custom click parameter type for handling multiple paths separated by OS path separator.

classes.name: AppGroup
classes.description: Custom click group that automatically wraps commands with application context.

classes.name: FlaskGroup
classes.description: Specialized click group for Flask CLI, supporting application loading, environment setup, and command management.

methods.name: find_best_app
methods.description: Finds the most suitable Flask app instance in a module by common attribute names or factory functions.

methods.name: find_app_by_string
methods.description: Resolves a Flask app instance from a string expression, which can be a variable or function call.

methods.name: prepare_import
methods.description: Converts a filename path into a Python module import path.

methods.name: locate_app
methods.description: Imports a module and finds or constructs a Flask application instance based on provided name or factory.

methods.name: get_version
methods.description: Outputs the current Python, Flask, and Werkzeug versions.

methods.name: load_dotenv
methods.description: Loads environment variables from dotenv files, supporting default files and custom paths.

methods.name: show_server_banner
methods.description: Displays startup messages for the Flask development server, including app path and debug status.

methods.name: _validate_key
methods.description: Validates and sets SSL key options for the Flask run command.
